meta.title: Faraday Probes and Arrays
meta.description: XHINS-FP single Faraday cups and probe arrays directly measure ion current density, divergence, and propellant utilization; support suppression grids, scanning, cooling, and multi-channel synchronous acquisition for thruster plume, plasma source, and process beam evaluation.
page.title: Faraday Probe
page.lead: Our Faraday probes directly measure ion beam or plasma beam current density and spatial distribution. Typical forms include single and dual Faraday cups for quantifying thruster plumes, plasma sources, and process beams.
single.title: Single Faraday Cup
single.tagline: Simple structure, easy calibration for single-point beam and total current measurement
single.overview: The XHINS-FP system is built for diagnosing plasma and ion beam characteristics. It measures ion current distribution to evaluate beam uniformity in etch tools, propellant utilization and energy loss in EP systems, plume divergence, and thrust vector alignment. The compact Faraday cup is easy to calibrate for point current and current density. Mounted on linear/rotary stages, it enables spatial scanning and beam profiling to locate non-uniformity and divergence sources. Suppression grids reduce secondary electron effects for higher accuracy.
single.feature1: Direct ion current measurement and quantification (pA–mA range)
single.feature2: Scanning-ready: compatible with linear/rotary mechanisms for spatial mapping
single.feature3: Configurable apertures/masks for spatial resolution and acceptance angle
single.feature4: Cooling/high-power options and KF/CF/custom flanges for easy integration

array.title: Faraday Probe Array
array.tagline: Multi-channel synchronous capture for transient spatial profiles
array.overview: Arrays combine multiple collectors for simultaneous channels, capturing transient spatial distributions and fast-changing beam structures. Linear or planar layouts with high-speed electronics deliver time-resolved profiles for pulsed or noisy environments.
array.feature1: Synchronous multi-channel sampling for transient spatial profiles
array.feature2: Array layouts for high-resolution profiling and differential analysis
array.feature3: Scalable channel count and dynamic range for strong/weak beams
array.feature4: Pairs with high-speed electronics for pulsed/transient analysis
